review: The staff ignored us for 15 minutes before taking our order.
Nice sit down restaurant feel, good for a family dinner.
The pizza was too oily for my taste, the box was soaked.
Tasty food but it is more expensive than other pizza chains.
Generous toppings on the Veggie Supreme and the sauce is tangy.
Delivery took over an hour and the pizza arrived lukewarm.
The pan pizza is thick, buttery and crispy at the edges, exactly how I like it.
The garlic bread and pasta were both good, we ordered seconds.
Stuffed crust is amazing, loads of cheese inside.
Our order was wrong twice and nobody apologised.
Drinks are flat and overpriced, skip them.
Birthday party for my son was handled really well by the manager.
The combo offers on weekdays are good value.
The app keeps logging me out and the coupons rarely apply.
Friendly waiter who suggested a great dessert.
